capabilities.input: Exactly three states: two nonnegative integer multiples of one unchanged compound scalar sum/product, ordered left/right factoring, then exact coefficient addition. Declared real scalars; no division, commutation or arbitrary solver. Editorial prose is not proof.

extraction.scope: Prediction/reconstruction with revision-pinned exact return; no automatic grading.

publication.input: selected composed source JSON; static reading/self-check edition, not interactive animation

diagnostic.expected: The result must equal the exact sum of the two coefficient integers.
